criteria.acceptance: The update plan has a schema, fixtures and a validator in CI.
Every policy deviation and every reliable WinGet upgrade becomes an action with its command or a manual marker, risk and reversibility.
Plan output is deterministic, local, privacy-safe, and identical on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.
No planning path runs a command or mutates the workstation (Sprint 7 gate still applies).
The plan is generated from a real PC #1 report on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.
criteria.manual: Run Run-Plan.cmd on the latest PC #1 report and record the summary in #176.
